Epa: Spirit of Oro-Ago

An installable mobile web app with touch controls, character styling, creative workshops, and solo activities. No app-store account or APK download is needed.

Play in browser

Checking installation options…

Android

  1. Open this site in Chrome using HTTPS.
  2. Tap Install app above when it appears.
  3. If no button appears, open Chrome’s menu and choose Install app or Add to Home screen. Availability depends on your browser.

iPhone and iPad

  1. Open this site in Safari using HTTPS.
  2. Tap Share, then Add to Home Screen.
  3. Enable Open as Web App if offered, then tap Add.

Offline play and updates

Visit the game online once and allow its files to finish loading before going offline. Core solo activities are cached on your device. Open the app online to receive new versions. Hosting and installation require HTTPS; do not bypass browser certificate warnings.

Your progress

Saves belong to the browser or installed-app environment where you play. A new browser, installation, or home-screen app may use different storage. Export your save in Player & settings before switching, then restore it in the installed app. This version has no cloud sync, multiplayer service, background calling or push notifications.
